==Notes==
*When you go to capture his elite skill, take a second signet of capture, [[Healing Burst]] is on your way.

== Trivia ==
* This NPC includes numerous references to the TV series, [[w:Firefly (TV series)|Firefly]]: he shares a (usually female) name with one of the show's main characters and both Jaynes have weapons named ''Vera''. In addition, his elite skill used to be called ''Serenity'', the name of the spaceship on the show.
